hook.say: This morning: Anthropic's new tools show what token spend actually delivers. I went back in and checked what other sources are measuring.

findings.label: RETENTION
findings.headline: Net revenue retention Anthropic shared with investors
findings.detail: Same customers spent nine times more in Q3 2026 than in Q3 2025, per TechCrunch.
findings.evidence: 900% net revenue retention — that is, spending from the same customers in Q3 2025 grew nine times in Q3 2026
findings.say: First, Anthropic told investors that the same customers now spend nine times more than a year ago. That is 900% net revenue retention, per TechCrunch.

findings.label: MARKET SHARE
findings.headline: Anthropic's share of token spend in Ramp's AI Index
findings.detail: Up from 51.3% four weeks earlier, among businesses tracked by Ramp.
findings.evidence: Anthropic’s share of token spending rose from 51.3% on September 25 to 60.5% on October 23.
findings.say: Second, among businesses in Ramp's AI Index, Anthropic's share of token spending rose from 51.3% to 60.5% in four weeks.

findings.label: BUDGET ALERTS
findings.headline: Alert levels on a pooled team budget
findings.detail: Admins are alerted at 50%, 75%, 95% and 100% of the shared monthly limit.
findings.say: Third, pooled team budgets send alerts at four points: 50%, 75%, 95% and 100% of the shared monthly limit.

take.headline: A bigger bill is not proof of value.
take.say: My take: rising spend proves people use it, not that it paid off. Measure output per dollar on one workflow before you scale.

caption:
This morning I covered Anthropic's new reporting tools that show what a team's token spend produced, what it cost and where workflows broke down.

I went back in for three more data points. 900% net revenue retention for Anthropic, per TechCrunch. Anthropic's share of token spend in Ramp's index rose from 51.3% to 60.5%. Pooled team budgets alert admins at 4 levels, from 50% to 100%.

My take: rising spend proves usage, not value. Measure output per dollar before you scale.
